subject: izzy-fiona
label: Affirmed by the universe, together
to: One night, both of them, identically — no Nereid involved
note:
Izzy and Fiona were childhood best friends who grew up side by side and stayed inseparable by choice. Their affection deepened into romance when they were adults. When Fiona's family demanded she choose another life and leave Izzy behind, Fiona refused; Izzy stood beside her, and they chose each other.

Years in a rented hotel room, odd jobs, and Fiona singing in the street for money. They crossed paths with the Found Family more than once and BRYN'S ADOPTION RADAR NEVER PINGED, because at the time they lacked the equipment. Then the universe said YOU'VE STRUGGLED ENOUGH, HERE. When it affirmed them both on the same night, they met the change with the curiosity they had always shared. As adults, they learned what they liked together, trading the lead, teasing each other, and building a playful intimacy on years of trust. That is why their records are identical to the decimal.
